title: Jello Block Mod
description: This project adds a new block only found in creative- Jello! Try to break it and you'll become a giant! This mod only works in version 1.21.1.
body:
This mod adds the Jello block to the game! You can only get it in creative and when destroyed, you become gigantic! Here's a list of what it adds:
Jello block with sound effects, Makes you giant using the /attribute command (I suggest using the scale version of the command with friends. It gets super chaotic.), and a message pops up in the hot bar. Destroy the block and see what it is!

Have fun!
